{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Champagne silk slip dress, bias cut, midi length, #f1dbaa, silk.
Cream linen blazer, tailored fit with wide lapels, hip length, #e2ba9f, linen.
Nude suede pumps, pointed toe, low block heel, #deb295, smooth leather.
Gold drop earrings, classic teardrop shape, #ffd700, gold vermeil.

This ensemble balances the formality required for a wedding with the warmth of a summer evening in August. The champagne slip dress offers elegance and comfort under the gazebo while transitioning seamlessly into the upscale restaurant setting. Adding a structured cream linen blazer provides necessary coverage against potential evening breezes without feeling overheated or overly heavy. The neutral color palette complements warm skin tones and allows the natural texture of the fabrics to shine under both outdoor daylight and indoor artificial lighting."}
